t: This is the former Royal Masonic Hospital, in the Ravenscourt Park area of Hammersmith. It was built and opened in nineteen thirty-three, and the building is Grade Two star listed. It became Ravenscourt Park Hospital in two thousand two, which closed in two thousand six. Several notable people died here, including Admiral of the Fleet Sir Dudley Pound, who commanded a battleship at the Battle of Jutland, and Percy Herbert, the first Bishop of Blackburn and later Bishop of Norwich.
